title: Balanced Brackets with String Literals
prompt:
Implement `is_valid_brackets(s: str) -> bool` in `solution.py`.
Check that bracket pairs `()`, `[]`, `{}` are properly matched and nested.
Any brackets occurring inside single (`'...'`) or double (`"..."`) string literals must be ignored!
Escaped quotes like `\"` or `\'` inside string literals must not terminate the string literal.
